title: Word Scramble
description: Unscramble the letters to find the correct word before time runs out!
how_to_play:
1. Press Play to start the game.
2. A scrambled word will appear on the screen.
3. Type the correct word using your keyboard.
4. Press Enter to submit your answer.
5. Earn points for correct answers and try to beat your high score.

Tips:
- Focus on recognizing patterns.
- Short words are easier to spot quickly.
- Keep practicing to get faster!
